summary: @downes @benwerd Spent some time today doing a deep dive into xAPI today. Simple enough but each "community of practice" inventing own "vocabulary" scares me. Seems expansive. we can do that already. We call it words.

body_html: @downes @benwerd Spent some time today doing a deep dive into xAPI today. Simple enough but each "community of practice" inventing own "vocabulary" scares me. Seems expansive. we can do that already. We call it words.
